_note: Constants for estimating the quantity of material from a floor plan alone (a rough estimate when there is no detailed drawing). Every entry is a range, never one number: use typical for a point estimate and show low to high. Values come from published rules of thumb and are NOT checked against the author's own bills yet (see CLAUDE.md). Cost shares and benchmarks are sanity checks on a total, never rates. Rates stay the user's.
